note: Two pages, three-column grids with dot leaders and names that wrap onto two lines ('EMERIL’S NEW ORLEANS / BARBECUE SHRIMP'). The restaurant name is a logo, not body text. Wording from the PDF text layer, layout checked against the rendered pages.
